about: Hymn file parsing. Each case is a whole .txt file and the attributes it should produce. See content/FORMAT.md.

cases.name: every attribute
cases.file:
name:: Amazing Grace
---
author:: John Newton
---
translator:: Someone
---
composer:: Unknown
---
arranger:: An Arranger
---
tune:: New Britain
---
collection:: Christmas
---
text::
Amazing grace! How sweet the sound

[Refrain]
That saved a wretch like me!

expect.name: Amazing Grace
expect.author: John Newton
expect.text:

[Refrain]
That saved a wretch like me!
